jobs.title: Entry IT Specialist, Power BI & Data Engineering - Aarhus
jobs.notes: In the Aarhus area and built around what you already do: developing and maintaining Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX and SQL for Arla's commercial teams, with Azure data engineering to grow into. They say a recent graduate or a few years of experience, so you clear the bar; lead with the Salesforce dashboards and the fintech database you own end to end. Honest gaps: the title is entry level, so pay may sit close to your floor (my guess, not stated), and part of the job is incident support. Over 100 people have clicked apply, so move soon.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.notes: Early-career BI role at a restaurant tech scale-up that is building a new data platform: SQL, data modelling, Power BI dashboards and KPI definitions, and Danish is explicitly not required. That is close to your market database and reporting work today. Honest gaps: the role sits in the FP&A team, so expect finance-flavoured questions, and they describe it as early career, so check the salary against your floor. Over 100 clicks on apply already.

jobs.title: Growth Analyst
jobs.salary: DKK 59,000 per month (stated in the ad)
jobs.notes: The closest thing to a product analyst role this week: you own the user funnel across apps and websites, write the SQL, design and read the experiments, and Danish is not required. Your GA4 and Tag Manager work at VELUX is the proof to lead with. Honest gaps: they ask for 3 to 5 years in product, growth or marketing analytics with experiment design, and you would present results to the people who decide what ships.

jobs.title: Data Science & BI Developer
jobs.notes: Sport and data in one job: Trackman builds the radar and camera tracking used by top athletes, and this team makes the BI reports and dashboards for customers and for internal teams. Dashboards, SQL and dimensional modelling are your ground. Honest gaps: they also want Python and hands-on machine learning (pandas, scikit-learn), which your CV does not show, it is on-site in Hørsholm, and the ad calls the environment fast-paced.

jobs.title: Process & Analytics Engineer (12-Month Contract)
jobs.commute: About 75 min from Aarhus C by car (est.)
jobs.notes: A way into LEGO: a 12 month contract in Packing and Packaging where you turn operational data into insights with Power BI, SQL, Python or Databricks and help prepare for more automation. Honest gaps: the other half of the job is documenting processes in SAP Signavio, which they list as a requirement, it is manufacturing rather than digital product, and there is no relocation support. Billund is more than an hour from Aarhus, so it only works if you live nearby or accept the drive three days a week.

jobs.title: Data Coordinator
jobs.notes: A hands-on data job at an Aarhus software company with English as the working language: you keep pricing data complete and correct, solve the hard customer data cases with Python and SQL, and turn one-off fixes into reusable tools and automation. Honest gaps: it is closer to data operations and web scraping than to analysis and dashboards, it is fully on-site, and the Coordinator title may mean pay near your floor (my guess, not stated). Posted yesterday with 27 clicks, so you would be early.

jobs.title: AI Business Partner (C&E)
jobs.notes: This is your wish to bring AI into a company, as a job: find AI use cases in a business area, build and ship working solutions yourself, and prove the value in numbers. Foxway is a circular IT company and English is the working language. Honest gap: they call it an experienced-level role and want a track record of AI solutions already delivered in a business, plus confidence with senior stakeholders. Lead with the research and reporting workflows you automated with Claude and your thesis on how employees adopt generative AI.

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst, Falcom, GN Group
jobs.notes: You would build the data structure behind a business unit's reporting: consolidating messy sources, dashboards for programmes, pipeline and deliveries, and they say interest in AI and automation is important. They ask for 2 to 5 years, which is where you are. Honest gaps: it is Excel first (Power BI and SQL are only a plus), on-site in Ballerup, and FalCom sells communication equipment to military and public safety users, so decide whether that sector is fine for you.

jobs.title: Advanced data analyst
jobs.notes: You would scope, build and maintain analytics products in Power BI for a production unit and guide student assistants, which you already do, and Danish is not required. Honest gap: they want at least 2 years from manufacturing, supply chain or a similar operational setting, which you do not have, so the pitch is owning a data product from idea to a tool people use. Posted yesterday.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Data (BI) Specialist
jobs.notes: Pure BI building: Power BI semantic models, advanced DAX and the reporting layer of a new Microsoft Fabric platform for the supply chain team at Nexi (Nets). Honest gaps: they want hands-on experience with Fabric or a similar platform and strong dimensional modelling, the listing is tagged mid-senior, and it is payments, which you ranked lower.

jobs.title: AI & Integrations Engineer
jobs.notes: AI automation as the whole job: find tasks AI agents can take over, build and deploy them and measure the time saved, inside a small data team at a fashion brand. Honest gap: it is an engineering profile. They ask for 2 to 3 years building data or AI solutions, strong Python, agents built on model APIs and a computer science type Master's. Worth a look only if you want to move toward building.

jobs.title: Generative AI Specialist
jobs.notes: Hands-on work on a live GenAI customer assistant used across the Nordics, and they say they are open to both junior and senior candidates. Honest gaps: this is an engineer role on production AI systems (LangGraph, Langfuse, Azure), and it is insurance, which you ranked lower. Over 100 clicks on apply.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.notes: Process and data role in the revenue team of a billing software company: forecasting, pipeline reporting and aligning systems across sales, marketing and finance. Your Salesforce reports and dashboards fit directly. Honest gaps: they want 2 to 3 years in revenue or sales operations, and it is more process than analysis or building.
